ProblemHeading: Compliance breaks down the moment work leaves the gate
ProblemBody: Cards expire, documents go stale, and the proof lives in inboxes and spreadsheets. On dispersed and retrofit work there's no gate to check anyone in at — so the gaps only show up when something goes wrong.
